text_simplified: Parents must teach their children the love of the Prophet Muhammad ﷺ and obedience to him, and to stay away from actions that anger him. They should also instill correct Islamic values in their children from a young age, such as truthfulness, amanah (trustworthiness), and good akhlaq (character).

review_defects.why: The Arabic specifies instilling values in the children's souls/hearts (نفوس), but the English omits this nuance, saying only 'in their children'.
